method: gh search issues <term> --repo Lightricks/ComfyUI-LTXVideo --sort comments (terms: tiled, out of memory, 4K, divisible, seam, crash, upscale, looping sampler, black, NaN, temporal); titles as filed, state on the check date
note: Not reproduced yet. Reproduction is ledger L7.107 (A13 s7 step 2); each reproduced failure gets a folder in crash_repros/.

issues.title: Width & height settings must be divisible by 32 + 1 Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. NOT
issues.why: Users trip over the size and frame-count rules; the resolution planner must make them impossible to get wrong.

issues.title: with RTX 5090 200GB RAM - ltx 2.3 is broken; it runs out of memory (OOM) when I increase the fr
issues.why: OOM grows with frame count even on 32 GB VRAM: target for the memory planner and temporal windows.

issues.title: Memory Error Launching LTX2 Text to Video (Distilled)
issues.why: Load-time memory failure; the planner should estimate before loading.

issues.title: Model v0.9.1 consumes much more VRAM
issues.why: Version-to-version VRAM regressions: benchmarks must name the model version.

issues.title: Example workflow causing oom, not the model !
issues.why: Workflow choices, not weights, cause OOM: baseline workflows must be recorded exactly.

issues.title: Missing Custom Node: LTXV Spatio Temporal Tiled VAE Decode
issues.why: Workflows break when a node is renamed or moved upstream: our workflows must not depend on upstream node names that change.

issues.title: Import failed - Possible upstream changes
issues.why: Upstream import breaks after core updates: integrate through stable core types, test oldest and newest core.

issues.title: Cannot import name 'pad'
issues.why: Same class: an internal name moved.

issues.title: Dark scenes render as flat mid-grey background instead of black (isolated to VAE zero-point)
issues.why: Padding with zeros in latent space is not 'black': padding must use a value that decodes to the intended colour, or pixel-space padding.

issues.title: [model BUG] VAE introduces ghosting artifacts. low noise v2v upscale cannot be usable.
issues.why: Ghosting in low-denoise v2v: a quality metric for the upscaling benchmarks.

issues.title: Video skipping / flickering problem with the IC HDR Lora
issues.why: Flicker from IC-LoRA passes: temporal-coherence metric needed.

issues.title: Input contains (near) NaN/+-Inf, LTX-2.3, ComfyUI
issues.why: NaN reaches the video encoder: a finite-check guard and a crash repro.

issues.title: video frames all blank
issues.why: Silent blank output: never return fake results; detect and report.

issues.title: LTX 2.3 22B — Pure noise/garbage output in ComfyUI
issues.why: Wrong weights/encoder combinations give noise: a pre-flight model check.

issues.title: LTX-2 - Still getting  mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied (1024x62208 and 188160x3840) e
issues.why: Text-encoder / connector mismatch: plain-English error mapping.

issues.title: Hope the "LTXV Looping Sampler" node can support audio latent looping
issues.why: Temporal windows must carry the audio latent too (LTX-2 is audio-video).

issues.title: Sometimes the video doesn't move for 1-2 seconds, or there is no sound.
issues.why: Frozen-start failure: a motion metric (first-second motion energy) in the benchmark.
